description: TensorAccessor address-calculation (get_noc_addr) CI golden (Blackhole, bh_p150_perf). Metric = device cycles per get_noc_addr call, computed as (SHARDED_ACCESSOR_<static> - EMPTY) / N over a single-zone loop of N=4096 calls on one core (device profiler), one all-static config per tensor topology, keyed by GetNocAddr.<topology>. Values left null are in record mode: the measured cycles/call is printed and the gate passes, so each arch/topology can be armed from its own scheduled baseline. Arm from two consecutive (Runtime) Performance Tests runs on bh_p150_perf; tolerance_pct 15% gives headroom for board/firmware drift while still catching real regressions.
pinned_config: unit_tests_ttnn_accessor AccessorBenchmarks.GetNocAddr, single core, all-static config per topology, device profiler, cycles/call = (ACCESSOR - EMPTY) / 4096
